obligations.statement: snapshot runs only when not_null(required) and (not_null(buffer) or capacity == 0); otherwise returns GF_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT, unchanged.
Unless not_null(required) and (not_null(buffer) or capacity == 0), snapshot changes nothing observable.
A stale identity (generational) is refused: returns GF_STATUS_STALE_HANDLE, changing nothing observable.
